adoptions.reason: Keep one capture path using existing Bevy screenshot/Viewer facilities; do not add bevy_capture or a second encoder framework
Revisit when choosing actual physics, VFX, audio or input backends; no automatic Rapier/Hanabi/Seedling dependency
The upstream all-skills router assumes the full collection; use the existing N:SIDE progress owners plus project specialist adapter
Narrow legacy review overlaps the selected reality check
Install only when a concrete task needs these workflows; Bevy camera and project art references cover current work
Use asset-specific budgets and GLB export; preserve rigs and sources; no universal Ctrl+A, fixed skeleton, 60 FPS or add-on framework
Preserve original references, retain existing narrative/review owners, one level-design Skill; reject universal metrics, mandatory LOD counts and middleware
Use state contracts, captured proof and bounded feedback; preserve narrative uncertainty; label nonisolated review self-audit and omit arcade score gates
Keep media inspection, temporal sampling, visual layers and asset representation; replace web architecture with project Bevy implementation brief
Keep stable anchors, separated geometry and state; reject mandatory flat gameplay plane, which conflicts with existing slopes, steps and bridges
Use event-role clarity, cleanup and recovery checks; no browser/mobile architecture or implemented-combat claims
Reuse the real scene/input path, wait for asynchronous screenshots and record assertions separately from observed visuals; keep locked Bevy
Keep source-image approval, alpha-edge contrast, asset scale and numeric QA where current assets support them; no second generation workflow
No scaffold, destructive publisher, external agent framework or paid-provider defaults
Project handbook maps retained methods to existing contracts and commands; attribution remains in each page and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES
